text:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up: Silverfall private deploy is blocked on two items: KMS access for their CI pipeline and audit-log delivery to their SIEM. want to triage now?

Ben Cho: I saw the pipeline fail in the morning run: kms:GenerateDataKey returns AccessDenied. likely key policy issue or role trust.

Priya Sharma: they shared their role ARN: arn:aws:iam::882233445566:role/silverfall-ci-role. did they grant that exact principal in the key policy?

Tom Keller: quick ask: can they run from the CI container: `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text` and paste result here? that will tell us assumed-role vs role ARN mismatch.

Lena Ortiz: pinged silverfall-ops in the ticket. also their SIEM endpoint is logs.silverfall-sec.internal -> 172.20.8.11 and our egress shows RSTs to that IP.

Ben Cho: for the KMS: common gotcha is people add the assumed-role ARN (with session) instead of the role ARN, or vice versa. key policy should reference the role arn, not the assumed-role session.

Priya Sharma: their key policy snippet they pasted: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::882233445566:role/silverfall-ci-role-session"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]}]}
```

Tom Keller: thats the problem — principal includes `-session`. they must use the role ARN (no session suffix). share sample: ```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::882233445566:role/silverfall-ci-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]}```

Lena Ortiz: asked them to patch and re-run. moving to egress: ops-bot trace shows our NAT gw -> 172.20.8.11:443 handshake timeout.

Ben Cho: if their logs endpoint is on private IP, need VPC peering / transit / private link. confirm DNS from our VPC resolves to 172.20.8.11?

Priya Sharma: recommended steps to Silverfall: 1) curl from an EC2 in our private subnet to https://logs.silverfall-sec.internal:443 -v, 2) paste output, 3) confirm their security group allows inbound from our NAT's IP.

Tom Keller: small troubleshooting tip: run `openssl s_client -connect 172.20.8.11:443 -servername logs.silverfall-sec.internal` from a NAT instance to check SNI cert mismatch.

Lena Ortiz: added temporary checklist item in the handoff doc: require "egress IPs + DNS + SG ingress" and "KMS principal exact ARN + assumed-role examples". saved to https://redwood.internal/onboarding/runbooks/private-vpc-checklist (note updated).

ops-bot: Runbook note: private-vpc-checklist updated by Lena Ortiz — 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z

Ben Cho: received get-caller-identity from their CI: `arn:aws:sts::882233445566:assumed-role/silverfall-ci-role/jenkins-01`. so they are assuming the role (normal). we still need role ARN in key policy.

Priya Sharma: flagged a compliance ask: if we change key policy during onboarding, audit team needs an approval record. propose we offer a temporary key alias restricted to onboarding window (24h) instead of changing customer-managed key. thoughts?

Tom Keller: temporary alias is ok if audit signs off. otherwise patching policy is normal but ask customer to provide change request.

Lena Ortiz: I will put both options in the ticket and ask which they prefer. also noting renewal risk: Silverfall is on a 30-day onboarding SLA and we're at day 5 with these last-mile items; not critical yet but track closely.

Ben Cho: if they want faster turn, we can do an adhoc zoom and apply the policy together. quicker than ticketing back and forth.

Priya Sharma: I added a note to our onboarding board to include "sample sts output" as required artifact — saves this loop.

ops-bot: Card created: ONB-9823 — Add sts sample and egress artifacts to private onboarding (assigned to Priya Sharma)

Tom Keller: follow-up: once key policy is corrected, I'll tail our NAT tcpdump during their re-run to confirm TLS handshake completes. command I'll run: `sudo tcpdump -n host 172.20.8.11 and port 443 -w /tmp/silverfall-ssh.pcap`

Lena Ortiz: update: Silverfall applied role-arn change and re-ran pipeline. one deploy passed, one log flush still failing. they suspect client cert mismatch on SIEM.

Ben Cho: ask them to attach client cert chain and curl output with `-v` so we can see TLS alert. also request their SIEM team check auth logs for incoming SSL rejects.

Priya Sharma: putting this as a close-loop item: when onboarding finishes, ask AM to capture feedback on onboarding docs — specifically the KMS principal confusion and add small examples.

Lena Ortiz: thanks team. I'll update ticket CS-5032 and loop AM if we hit 48h stall. will also schedule a 30m pairing session if they want help. :white_check_mark:
